changelog: **Affiliate module, release (#3119):** the affiliate programme gets its feature-catalogue card (`src/lib/features.ts`, tagged `capability: 'affiliate'`, so only the marketing product lists it), and two `@smoke` specs close the story's acceptance: `affiliate-end-to-end.spec.ts` drives partner → customer → payment → commission → payout through the real APIs and checks the partner sees only its own rows (another partner's payout 404), and `affiliate-internship-host.spec.ts` sweeps every affiliate API and page — read from the file system, so new routes are covered automatically — and asserts none answers on the internship product, with a marketing control. Final whole-module review fixes: a migrated partner's `ended_on` without TERMINATED is refused (never dropped) and a payout dated before its payments is refused; a terminated partner gets no NEW customer after the termination takes effect (`partner_terminated`) and a payout is never dated before what it pays accrued (`payout_before_accrual`); the commissions screen confirms every move with its count and sum (a rejection says it is final) and loads the drift list on request, now three queries for the whole programme; the partner list reads masked IBANs without a query per partner; the portal shows a customer's first payment day; `affiliate-authz-matrix.spec.ts` (@smoke) pins cross-organisation writes and PROGRAM_ADMIN refusals.
